title: Last Torch
description: This is a simple mod that prevents you from placing the last torch in your off-hand.
body:
**Last Torch is a lightweight and essential helper mod that prevents you from accidentally placing the last torch you’re holding in your off-hand. This ensures you always have a light source while exploring deep caves.**

**Supported Items:**
- Torch
- Soul Torch
- Lantern
- Soul Lantern
